items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1975-02-19
items.q: the only time when I actually ever produced a bebop concert... which featured Lenny Tristano and Fats Navarro and Billy Bauer

ctx.x: And the first concert I brought in, in fact, for them, in fact, the only time when I actually ever produced a bebop concert, which I did not produce under my own name, but which featured Lenny Tristano and Fats Navarro and Billy Bauer and certain other musicians whose activity was significant at that time. You asked about Miles Davis before. Mm-hmm. I met Miles Davis in Philadelphia, too.
